ads.title: HR Operations & Payroll Specialist, Nordic
ads.quote: Acting as the key interface towards the outsourced payroll provider, the role ensures accurate payroll execution, data integrity, compliance and efficient people administration throughout the employee lifecycle.

ads.title: Specialist/Senior Specialist, Payroll Services
ads.quote: You will contribute to payroll and time management transformation projects, coordinate with external providers and internal stakeholders, perform pre- and post-payroll reconciliations, and ensure legal and tax compliance.

ads.title: Manager, Group Control
ads.quote: Partner with Finance Development and relevant process owners to identify and define AI-enabled improvements to reporting and planning controls, validation and reconciliation, and support their implementation.

ads.title: Service Coordinator/Engineer
ads.quote: Planning/coordinating/administrating service jobs globally by using our extensive service network.
